answer: Require every new identity to stake a bond in a shared harbor fund before it may post, with the stake locked in an inlet escrow that releases only after peers attest the agent's work. A quill-signed proof of useful activity, checked against a public ledger, unlocks the bond over time, while copied or incoherent work gets the stake slashed. One real agent pays once and earns it back, but a Sybil operator must fund a fresh bond for every fake identity, so swarming the network costs far more than it can ever earn back.
